# spot

> A Go library that models RFC 7946 GeoJSON geometry types as structs, with functional constructors, strict JSON round-tripping, and an Elasticsearch `geo_shape` query builder.

## Overview

`spot` represents RFC 7946 GeoJSON geometry types (Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection) as idiomatic Go structs, plus the Elasticsearch geo-shape extensions Envelope and Circle. Every type has a functional `NewXxx(...)` constructor and `MarshalJSON`/`UnmarshalJSON` with strict round-tripping.

The top-level module is client-agnostic. A bundled subpackage, `github.com/heltonmarx/spot/eshape`, builds the Elasticsearch `geo_shape` query DSL on top of Elastic's official `go-elasticsearch` client.

## Quick Start

```sh
go get github.com/heltonmarx/spot
```

```go
import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/heltonmarx/spot"
)

func main() {
	s := spot.NewShape(spot.WithPoint([]float64{-122.42, 37.77}))
	data, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(data))
	// {"coordinates":[-122.42,37.77],"type":"point"}
}
```

## Key Concepts

- Discriminated `Shape` container: a `Type` field plus a single concrete geometry pointer, so any geometry can be held in one value.
- Strict RFC 7946 coordinate ordering: longitude first, then latitude.
- Client-agnostic top-level module (`github.com/heltonmarx/spot`); the `eshape` subpackage depends on `go-elasticsearch`.

## API Reference

- Core types: `Shape`, `Point`, `LineString`, `Polygon`, `GeometryCollection`, `Circle`, `Envelope` (and the remaining RFC 7946 types `MultiPoint`, `MultiLineString`, `MultiPolygon`).
- `NewShape(...Option)` builds a `Shape`; `NewXxx(...)` constructors build each geometry.
- `eshape.GeoShapeQuery` builds the Elasticsearch `geo_shape` query DSL.

## Common Patterns

Build a shape, then marshal it:

```go
s := spot.NewShape(spot.WithPoint([]float64{-122.42, 37.77}))
data, err := json.Marshal(s) // and json.Unmarshal to round-trip
```

## Error Handling

- `UnmarshalJSON` returns an error when it encounters an unknown geometry type.
- `MarshalJSON` and serialization helpers return errors that must be handled by the caller.
